summary: Verified client-side Enhance Suite. All 7 enhance modes (auto/hdr/sharpen/denoise/upscale/color_pop/lowlight) and Magic Enhance run entirely on-device with ZERO calls to /api/ai/enhance. Each mode mutates image pixels (src changes), shows correct success toast, and no 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY not configured' errors appear. Upscale correctly doubles dimensions (400x300 -> 800x600). Undo reverts the last enhance op.
critical_code_review_comments: imageUtils.js is 567 lines — acceptable now but approaching split threshold; consider splitting enhance helpers into /lib/enhance.js if growing further.

Canvas2D 'willReadFrequently' warning logged by browser for getImageData-heavy ops (_applyPixelOp, _autoLevelsOnCanvas, _unsharpMask). Low priority perf hint: pass {willReadFrequently:true} when calling getContext('2d') on canvases used for readback.
seed_data_creation: generated in-browser 400x300 dull PNG written to /tmp/test_input.png for file_input upload
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enhance suite fully client-side verified. Test script intercepts page.on('request') filtering '/api/ai/' to prove zero network calls. Emergent badge hidden via CSS before clicks. Export uses window.showSaveFilePicker fallback so Playwright download event may not always fire — this is expected and not a bug.
